node.statement: For every Y, exact unitality, U^dagger bold-dot U=J, the associator bound, and the product-norm bound give ||Y||=||(U^dagger bold-dot U) bold-dot Y||<=e||U||^2||Y||+(1+e)||U|| ||U bold-dot Y||. Using e<=1/64 and ||U||<=2 yields ||U bold-dot Y||>=(1-4e)/(2(1+e))*||Y||>=(6/13)||Y||. Thus L_U is injective; finite dimensionality makes L_U bijective, and ||L_U^{-1}||<=13/6<3.
